title: Timer retry, pending, locking, and rollback semantics fail
notes: Cluster H from the final integration run: TC-SCH-303-04, TC-SCH-02-02, and TC-SCH-02-03 fail on retry/pending semantics, rollback expectations, and one PostgreSQL 55P03 row-lock conflict on instance_projections. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 8499-8545 and 16647-16874.
root_cause: TBD. Initial hypothesis: timer polling and retry transactions lock/update instance projections in an inconsistent order and do not preserve the expected pending state after rollback or retry failure.
candidate_resolution: Specify the timer state machine and transaction boundaries, use deterministic lock ordering or SKIP LOCKED semantics, and make retry/rollback transitions atomic with projection updates.
resolution: Fixed by commit 6b042542 (WF03-GH567, PR #572, merged 2026-08-08). TC-SCH-02-02: scheduler.zig now counts skipped_locked for ordinary-timer SKIP LOCKED branch. TC-SCH-02-03: fire_blk no longer swallows appendTimerFiredEventInTx errors — TransactionFailed is surfaced. TC-SCH-303-04: passes (4/4). All 23 SCH-02 and 4 SCH-303 tests green as of 2026-08-09 on main.
prevention: Use --summary all in CI to catch silent test swallowing
Audit fire_blk patterns for catch break that silently demotes errors
